messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — dashboards for token-latency on /generate show big gaps starting ~2026-02-28 01:12 UTC. per-token breakdown missing for many requests. Anyone else seeing this?
Samir Patel: saw the same. Correlates with kernel-selection rollout 2h ago. Could be tags exploding.
OpsBot: deploy complete for runtime-kernel-picker v2 at 2026-02-28T01:07:45Z by samir. Rollout 30%.
Li Wang: looking at exporter logs — seeing repeated errors: 'udp: write: message too long' and 'buffer overflow, dropping metrics' around the same time.
Li Wang: logs:
```
2026-02-28T01:12:18Z exporter/statsd ERROR Dropped 1213 metrics: packet_size=65535
2026-02-28T01:12:18Z exporter/statsd WARN high-cardinality tag: kernel=kv_v2-quant-8-bit-rax-20260228-4
2026-02-28T01:12:18Z exporter/otel INFO buffered_metrics=0
```
Maya Chen: that kernel tag looks terrible — we never intended to surface the full kernel fingerprint as a metric tag. That creates a unique series per config.
Samir Patel: yep, I added the full fingerprint for debugging in v2. I thought it was temporary. My mistake.
Eva R.: quick remediation options:
- sanitize kernel tag to canonical short id (e.g., kv_v2.q8)
- collapse metrics to per-route histograms rather than per-token-series where possible
- enable aggregation on the exporter (client-side sampling / histogram buckets)
Tony: also consider increasing UDP buffer and switching to batching-over-TCP for high-cardinality paths.
Li Wang: I can push a sanitizer to the statsd encoder and a guard in the runtime to limit tag length -> PR ready.
Samir Patel: I'll revert the fingerprinting change from runtime immediately (PR 4123).
Maya Chen: we still need to recover the missing points — traces include token timestamps. Can we backfill?
Li Wang: yes — traces are in S3://redwood-prod/traces/2026-02-28/. I wrote a backfill utility that scans spans and reconstructs per-route/token histograms, then emits aggregated metrics via OTel. Command: `python tools/metrics_backfill.py --start 2026-02-28T01:00 --end 2026-02-28T02:30 --routes /generate --bucket=100ms`
Samir Patel: run the backfill on a small window first. Also I'll coordinate to keep the rollout paused until sanitizer is live.
OpsBot: CI: PR 4123 merged by samir. Deploy queued.
Eva R.: for the exporter config, recommended StatsD settings: `max_packet_size=1400`, `batch_interval_ms=200`, and sanitize tags by mapping long fingerprints to a one-byte code. Also add a dropped-metrics gauge to alert sooner.
Li Wang: starting backfill now for 01:00-01:30 window. ETA ~45m. I'll post progress logs.
Tony: ops infra — can we bump receive buffer on exporter nodes to 4MB temporarily? This should reduce immediate drops while the patch rolls out.
Maya Chen: Action list: Samir revert+sanitize (PR 4123) — done/merged, Li run backfill (in progress), Tony/infra bump UDP buffer (ops), Eva add backfill progress widget to dashboard.
Samir Patel: running with sanitizer locally then will promote. Will also add mapping table so dashboards show readable kernel codes not raw fingerprints.
Maya Chen: thanks all. Please ping if you see any further metric gaps.
Tony: :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Li Wang: progress update in 20m — backfill partial results look sane (histograms match traces).
Maya Chen: great, keeping this thread open until the dashboard shows steady state.
